answer: Seeded slot lottery.** Each epoch a public random beacon assigns agents to interaction slots; only slot holders can transact, and assignments are revealed just before use. An attacker cannot precompute which identities will win, so flooding fake agents yields no predictable access. To hold a violet slot repeatedly, an attacker must control many identities across uncertain draws. A terrace queue caps pending registrations, forcing real wait time per identity, while a garden diversity rule limits any cluster to a small share of slots.
